summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Synaptra Studio rebuild with React Router. Identified critical frontend data flow issue in Task Runner execution pipeline and metrics display. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate), but Task Runner component not properly displaying task execution data when tasks are selected from sidebar.

integration_issues.issue: Execution pipeline and metrics not populating when selecting tasks from sidebar
integration_issues.details: When clicking on tasks in the Task Runner sidebar, the execution pipeline shows 'Awaiting execution' and metrics show '—' instead of actual task data. Backend APIs return complete task data with execution_steps and evaluation scores, but frontend doesn't display them.
integration_issues.root_cause: Frontend data flow issue in TaskRunner.jsx - selectedTask state not properly populated or rendered

passed_tests: System status API returns 'operational' with AI engine 'ready' and database 'connected'
Dashboard loads with proper layout and hero card (SYNAPTRA STUDIO title, 3 quick action buttons)
Sidebar navigation works correctly between all pages (Dashboard, Task Runner, Automations, Memory, Tools, History, Settings)
All pages render without JavaScript errors
Task creation API works correctly (backend processes tasks successfully)
Task list displays in Task Runner sidebar (8 tasks found)
History page displays completed tasks with correct data (scores: 85.4, 80.5, 78.8, 82.2, 73.5, 83.4)
History page shows task input text, type, status, and timestamps correctly
Backend API endpoints all return correct status codes (100% success rate)
Task persistence and retrieval working properly
AI integration with openai library operational
Direct API calls from browser work correctly (/api/status, /api/tasks, /api/tasks/{id})
Backend returns complete task data with execution_steps (5 steps) and evaluation scores
Task status shows 'completed' in backend responses
Frontend can fetch and display task lists
Enterprise-grade UI design maintained with proper dark theme
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix Task Runner frontend data flow issue. When selecting tasks from sidebar, execution pipeline and metrics are not displaying. Backend APIs return complete data (execution_steps, evaluation scores, output) but TaskRunner.jsx component is not properly rendering this data. The selectedTask state or rendering logic needs to be fixed to display: 1) Execution pipeline steps with completion status, 2) Metrics scores (Quality, Relevance, Efficiency, Overall), 3) Task output content. History page works correctly, proving data is available.

success_percentage.integration: 75% (data flows correctly but Task Runner display broken)
